Name: Asta's Portraits-RSV Male Marriageable Candidates
Author: AstaEckhart
Description:
Although I had drawn portraits of Jio and Philip last year, I wasn’t fully satisfied with them, so I decided to redraw them. Ian’s portrait also received some detailed touch-ups.

This mod includes  High-resolution portraits for ten male marriage candidates from RSV, with seasonal, rainy, Spirit’s Eve, and Flower Dance.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18202]Seasonal Outfits for Ridgeside Village[/url] is not required, but it will enhance your immersion!

Zayne Portraits is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17813]here[/url]

◆ How to use

1. Download these mods (Portraiture, PortraiturePlus, RSV)
2. Place the pictures in Portraiture in the corresponding folder (the path is: \Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\{the folder you named})
3. Finish!

*PortraiturePlus is essential, without it the corresponding seasonal portraits will not be displayed

*If you don’t need the seasonal portrait, you can ignore this and delete the seasonal portrait PNG
*If you have installed other avatar mods for the same character, please check for conflicts.

The original author of the costume is Rafseazz.
Clothe For Spirit's Eve were made with AirynS, Arknir27, Asterisk555, Bunnipocalypse, Elaho, PlatinumCats,  Nin the Cactus.
Thank for their Hard work!
I'm very sorry that I forgot to include my thanks in the initial upload!
